title: narratr scenes
description: The contract between Claude and the renderer. Claude produces this; every stage after it is deterministic. The document it is written from is arbitrary, so this file is treated as untrusted input: every string is bounded and anything that reaches a selector, a path or a subprocess argument is constrained to a charset.

title.description: Becomes the run directory name, so it is held under a single filesystem component.

block_ids.description: Every leaf block in the source document. Pass 1 must map all of them.

coverage.description: block_id -> scene_id. Validated as a hard gate before any compute is spent.

reference.description: path to a 10s reference clip. Containment under the repo is enforced in Python, not here.

seed.description: Passed to torch.manual_seed, which rejects values outside its 64-bit range -- after the model has already loaded.

speed.description: playback tempo; below 1 is slower. Defaults to 0.92, which suits following rather than skimming. Pitch is unchanged and narration is not regenerated.

type.description: Each type needs its own field: 'diagram' needs 'mermaid', 'code' needs 'code', 'flow' needs 'steps', 'cards' needs 'cards'. 'prose' needs nothing beyond narration -- a heading alone is a section card. That requirement is enforced in narratr.spec, which names the scene and the missing field.

narration.description: Spoken text. This is the master clock: its rendered duration sets the scene length. 5000 characters is roughly eight minutes of speech for one scene, far past the 30-60s a scene is written for.

bullets.description: Fragments, never sentences. Six objects max per slide. A plain string is a bullet with no icon.

icon.description: Lucide icon name, kebab-case. Validated against the installed pack before any compute.

state.description: struck: the approach being rejected. Dimmed with a line through it.

cue.description: Reserved. Verbatim phrase from this scene's narration; not yet resolved.

mermaid.description: diagram scenes only. Handed to mermaid-cli as a subprocess input, so it is bounded here.

revealSteps.description: Groups of SVG node ids revealed as beats across the scene.

items.description: A Mermaid node id. Interpolated into a CSS attribute selector by the renderer, so it is held to the charset Mermaid itself allows for node ids -- the same charset as scenes[].id.

code.description: code scenes only. Highlighted by Shiki and laid out on one slide; 20000 characters is already far more than a slide can show.

lang.description: Shiki language id, e.g. 'python', 'c#', 'objective-c'. Not enumerated -- Shiki supports hundreds and an enum would go stale -- but constrained to the shape a language id has.

steps.description: flow scenes. A sequence, revealed one step at a time. Beyond five steps it is a diagram.

label.description: A word or two under the icon.
A word or two under the icon.

footer.description: flow scenes. The condition holding across every step, shown below the chain.

cards.description: cards scenes. Parallel things side by side, revealed one at a time.

detail.description: One short line. Never a sentence.
